work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CCXXX, addressed Venerabili fratri archiepiscopo Iconiensi (LF39447–39448), appoints him apostolic delegate for Oriental ecclesiastical affairs in place of Bishop Losanna of Abydos and ends with its own 7 June 1833 closing at LF39538–39541; its provenance note LF39544 and the leaf-275 header follow. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF39451–39451; the source closing at LF39538–39541 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die septima iunii.millesimo octingen- tesimo trigesimo tertio, pontificatus Nostri anno tertio. The synopsis caption begins mid-sentence in OCR (LF39442 cere statuitur ...); it is edition furniture and wholly excluded. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
